name: Hindustan Copper Ltd.
business_summary: Government-owned (60.1% after the Aug 2026 OFS) copper-ore miner and concentrator: Khetri, Malanjkhand, Indian Copper Complex and Rakha, with a small cathode/rod tail. Sells concentrate (e.g. to Hindalco) and cathode linked to LME copper. Q1 FY27 sales Rs936 cr, EBITDA Rs508 cr (54%), PAT Rs352 cr (+162%). TTM sales Rs3,498 cr, PAT Rs1,137 cr; market cap Rs41,485 cr; capex plan Rs7,000 cr over 5-6 years; QIP of ~9.69 crore shares and Rs500 cr NCD approved at the Sep 2026 AGM.

exposures.mechanism: Sells concentrate/cathode priced off LME (record >$14,000/t) with mostly fixed mining cost. TTM sales Rs3,498 cr, EBITDA Rs1,758 cr (50%). +10% copper = +Rs350 cr revenue ~ +20% EBITDA at constant cost; EV/MCap ~1.0, persistence 0.5 => ~+10, cut to 6 because the price already discounts record copper (P/E 34x) and for provisional-pricing lags. Pack empirical +4.16 (t=+3.5).

evidence.note: The Hindu: copper seen above $14,000; HCL banks on cost discipline
empirical +4.16 per +10% copper, t=+3.5; Q1 FY27 OPM 54%

exposures.mechanism: Realisation = LME x USD/INR; costs INR. +3% => +Rs105 cr revenue (~6% EBITDA); x0.5 persistence => ~+3. Empirical +2.9 (t=+1.2).
Diesel, explosives and power ~15% of cost (model estimate); +10% Brent lifts those ~4% => costs +0.6% => EBITDA -1.2% x0.5 => ~-0.5.

evidence.note: cost split not disclosed in pack; model estimate

exposures.mechanism: Royalty on copper is ~4% of LME-linked metal value (model knowledge); a hike or new levy cuts a 50% margin: +1 unit ~ -1pp realisation => ~-2% EBITDA, widened for reform uncertainty.

evidence.note: Upstox: AGM to consider QIP and Rs500 cr NCD

exposures.mechanism: Scarcity theme: the only integrated Indian copper-ore miner; Rs7,000 cr capex over 5-6 years (2026-09-22) is valued on structural copper demand from EVs, grids, data centres. Re-rating channel not in spot copper.

evidence.note: Economic Times: Rs7,000 cr capex in next 5 years

exposures.mechanism: China consumes ~55% of copper; +1pp growth supports LME (price effect in F_COPPER); residual is rerating/beta.
Near debt-free (interest Rs6 cr TTM); only the discount-rate effect on a high-multiple small cap.
High-beta PSU mid cap (1y vol 53%); FII holding 7.1% rose after the OFS; flows drive liquidity/valuation (govt sold 6% at a 10% discount in Aug).

evidence.note: New Indian Express: Rs3,000 cr raised via OFS

supply_chain.note: major concentrate buyer (model knowledge, share unverified)
OFS of up to 6% completed Aug 2026
